idea-plugin.name: EUDI Wallet Request Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Nine rules that read the JSON your service sends to an EU Digital Identity Wallet

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → EUDI Wallet Request Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 9 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/eudi-rp-request-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/eudi-rp-request-lint

action.text: EUDI Wallet Request Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run EUDI Wallet Request Lint on the file in the editor
